create_submission_file_oc20: create an evalAI submission file for OC20 dataset by joining id, ood_ads, ood_cat, and ood_both split results
create_submission_file_oc22: create an evalAI submission file for OC22 dataset by joining id and ood split results
write_is2re_relaxations_from_traj: write IS2RE relaxation predictions from ASE trajectory files by extracting system ids and potential energies
write_is2re_hybrid_predictions: write IS2RE predictions from hybrid S2EF NPZ files using force and energy model results
run_make_submission_cli: run the CLI script with --id, --out-path, and --dataset flags to generate a compressed NPZ submission file
